notes: Improved Outfit Collection planning, pot selection, and collection progress handling.
Improved Outfit Collection usability with clearer pot permissions, planning statuses, and refresh behavior.
Improved repeated Outfit Collection scans by reusing verified pot catalog data during the current session.
Fixed Outfit Collection plan synchronization after completed submissions and configuration changes.
Improved automation recovery and state handling across supported game activities.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Improved Outfit Collection with clearer Collection Categories and selectable pot permissions.
Added a dedicated pot manager showing which available outfit pots are Allowed or Protected from automation use.
Improved Collection Plan summaries with clearer completion, waiting, manual synthesis, catalyst, and unavailable statuses.
Collection category and pot-selection changes now update the plan without requiring another full game scan.
Improved repeated game-state refreshes by reusing verified pot catalog data during the current session.
Improved slow-server handling across Collection navigation, Inventory transitions, pot selection, and synthesis.
Improved Outfit Collection with Low Purify Stone support, exact outfit variant matching, category-aware Collection routing, and synthesis retry recovery.
Improved overall automation recovery and state handling across supported game activities.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Fixed Outfit Collection plan counters becoming out of sync after an outfit was successfully completed and submitted.
Fixed pot-selection changes causing reviewed plans and executable actions to become inconsistent.
Fixed unchecked outfit pots being presented with misleading availability terminology.
Fixed cases where Outfit Collection could require unnecessary repeated scans after planning-only configuration changes.
Fixed recovery cases where automation could remain stuck or repeat interactions after delayed or interrupted game states.
